title: Interim Finance Data Analyst
description:
Interim Finance Data Analyst - 3-6 Month FTC

We are working with our London-based client, a fast-growing, private equity-backed hospitality group, to recruit an Interim Finance Data Analyst on an initial 3-6 month fixed-term contract. Immediate availability is preferred.

With a growing multi-site operation across key European cities, the business is looking for someone with strong financial data analysis and reconciliation experience to support the finance team during an exciting period of growth.

Salary: £60,000-£70,000 (pro rata)

Working arrangement: Full-time, office-based, 5 days a week (London Bridge).

The Role

Reporting into the senior finance team, you will take ownership of financial data analysis and reconciliation, with a particular focus on merchant services, payment processing and balance sheet integrity.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Analysing large volumes of financial and transactional data across multiple sites.
  • Reconciling merchant services, card payments and payment provider settlements.
  • Investigating discrepancies between EPOS systems, payment platforms, bank receipts and finance records.
  • Completing balance sheet reconciliations and resolving historic or aged balances.
  • Identifying data inconsistencies, investigating root causes and implementing improvements.
  • Working with finance and operational teams to improve reconciliation processes and financial controls.
What We're Looking For
  • Previous experience in a Finance Analyst, Finance Data Analyst or similar role.
  • Strong, hands-on merchant services and payment reconciliation experience.
  • Experience handling and analysing large datasets.
  • Strong balance sheet reconciliation experience.
  • Background in a multi-site hospitality, leisure or retail environment.
  • Advanced Excel skills and strong analytical ability.
  • A proactive, hands-on approach with the ability to work independently and deliver within tight deadlines.
  • Immediately available or able to start at short notice.

Please quote 52803 when emailing Hayley at Alexander Lloyd (hbu@alexanderlloyd).

This is just one of many vacancies we are handling. Alexander Lloyd is a leading recruiter across Finance and Accountancy, covering Financial Reporting, Management Accounts, FP&A, Commercial Finance and Finance Director appointments throughout Surrey, Sussex, London and Kent.

Due to the high volume of applications, we are unfortunately unable to respond to every applicant individually. If you do not hear from one of our consultants, you have not been shortlisted for this role. Please continue to check our website for other opportunities.
